set.body: Follow-up from the typed-lucidity pass. Audit Surface.at, Grid.indexAt/cellCentre, Mass.mean, and related public collection APIs. Make out-of-domain sampling explicit rather than partial, use non-empty inputs where emptiness is meaningless, and distinguish intentionally unsafe internal indexing by name and visibility. Preserve the current efficient inner loops and add boundary/adversarial tests.
set.title: Make surface sampling total and aggregation non-empty
